purpose: Govern multilingual terminology systems and mapping products that can connect SNOMED CT and ICD-10 while preserving whether the connection is direct, hub-mediated, pivot-mediated, or interface-only.
topology_policy: Only an authority-published SNOMED-to-ICD map is direct. Shared concept identifiers, OMOP standardization, multilingual labels, and two maps joined through ORPHA or MedDRA are mediated paths and may not be promoted to exact translation equivalence.

resources.name: UMLS Metathesaurus 2026AA
resources.snomed_endpoint: edition-specific SNOMED source atoms and map sets
resources.icd_endpoint: WHO and national ICD-10 source families represented by exact SAB and VSAB
mapping_mechanisms: MRMAP or MRSMAP map-set rows where present
MRCONSO CUI co-membership as candidate-only linkage
resources.semantic_boundary: CUI co-membership is neither a direct crosswalk nor proof that labels are translations. Preserve SAB, VSAB, AUI, CODE, REL, RELA, map direction and source licence.
resources.rights_gate: active UMLS licence, valid UTS account, Appendix 1 source restrictions and SNOMED Appendix 2

resources.name: NLM SNOMED CT mapping products and browsers
resources.snomed_endpoint: SNOMED CT US or International edition as named by the map package
resources.icd_endpoint: ICD-10 or ICD-10-CM as named by the map package
mapping_mechanisms: map rules, advice, groups and priorities
resources.semantic_boundary: The browser is an access interface, not an independent dataset. A map package applies only to its exact edition, target classification and effectiveTime; Spanish SNOMED availability does not make an English map multilingual.
resources.rights_gate: UMLS and SNOMED affiliate terms plus target ICD licence and jurisdiction-specific redistribution terms

resources.name: OMOP Standardized Vocabularies distributed through Athena
resources.snomed_endpoint: OMOP Standard Concepts, principally SNOMED for conditions
resources.icd_endpoint: ICD-10 family source concepts including jurisdiction-specific vocabularies
mapping_mechanisms: external SNOMED-ICD and UMLS mapping inputs
resources.semantic_boundary: Maps to can be exact, broader, split, or domain-transforming. Athena is the authenticated distribution interface, not a separate evidence lineage; concept names do not constitute a multilingual parallel corpus.
resources.rights_gate: Athena account and per-vocabulary licences, including SNOMED, MedDRA and ICD-family terms

resources.name: Orphadata rare-disease alignments
resources.snomed_endpoint: separate English SNOMED CT-Orphanet nomenclature map
resources.icd_endpoint: multilingual ORPHA alignments to ICD-10 and ICD-11
resources.semantic_boundary: The two products can form a candidate path through an ORPHA identifier, but they are not a native SNOMED-to-ICD map and their language vintages differ. Preserve product, language, direction and mapping cardinality.
resources.rights_gate: product-specific Orphadata licence plus SNOMED and ICD target rights

resources.name: MedDRA and SNOMED CT map family
resources.snomed_endpoint: official MedDRA-SNOMED CT bidirectional map edition
resources.icd_endpoint: ICD relationships supplied by an independently identified map or governed hub
mapping_mechanisms: UMLS, OMOP or Orphadata ICD relationship only when separately sourced
resources.semantic_boundary: MedDRA multilingual releases do not create multilingual SNOMED-ICD mappings. Never infer an ICD edge from MedDRA hierarchy or shared terms; require a separately versioned ICD relation and collapse shared UMLS or OMOP derivation.
resources.rights_gate: MedDRA subscription, exact language pack, SNOMED licence, map terms and target ICD rights

language_policy: Language belongs to the exact source atom, edition and map product. Do not propagate language across CUI, OMOP concept_id, ORPHA code, MedDRA code, SNOMED edition or ICD variant, and never collapse regional variants.
